Maya (CS Ops): heads up — I'm going to run a small CRM hygiene + healthscore tweak on a test cohort this afternoon. Need owners for rollback, and someone to watch for unintended playbook churn.
Liam (CS Eng): which cohort + size?
Maya (CS Ops): ~30k accounts: trial->active funnel where last_touch > 90d but product_events_last_30d > 0. SQL below for sampling:
```sql
SELECT account_id, region, sample_hash%100 AS sample_pct
FROM accounts
WHERE lifecycle = 'trial'
  AND last_touch < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND product_events_last_30d > 0
  AND flags_notified = false
```
Priya (Enablement): :+1: should we exclude manual_hold and enterprise pilot tags? Also ensure playbooks don't double-fire.
Maya (CS Ops): good call — adding exclusion filter `AND manual_hold = false AND pilot_tag = false`. Playbook side: we'll run in dry-run mode (no outgoing nudges) then run a soft nudge after 48h if no regressions.
Ezra (CSM): canary by region? i'd prefer EMEA first.
Maya (CS Ops): yes — canary policy: `region = 'EMEA' AND (sample_hash % 100) < 5` for 5% canary. then 25% -> 100% over 7 days if metrics look good.
PlaybookBot: dry-run scheduled (run_id=run-579-a) — scheduled for 2025-11-09T16:00:00Z. Mode: dry-run. Targets: cohort_v3, exclusions applied.
Liam (CS Eng): who will watch for healthscore drift / playbook churn? set up alert thresholds pls.
Priya (Enablement): i'll monitor the healthscore dashboard (dashboards.prod/reports/healthscore-cohort-v3) and the playbook event stream. i'll add eval hooks to compare 'at-risk' tag rate and onboarding progression pre/post.
Ezra (CSM): if 'at-risk' tag increases >3pp or onboarding completion drops >2pp in canary, we rollback and open #release-war-room.
Maya (CS Ops): rollback plan: run dry-run -> review tomorrow 10:00 PT -> proceed soft nudge 5% canary EMEA -> 25% -> 100% across regions. cc owners.
Liam (CS Eng): i'll prep rollback SQL/script. putting here so it's copy-paste ready:
```sql
-- rollback: remove hygiene flags applied by run-579-a
UPDATE accounts
SET hygiene_flag = false, healthscore = previous_healthscore
WHERE metadata->>'hygiene_run_id' = 'run-579-a';
```
Maya (CS Ops): thanks. i'll add this to the runbook and tag the PR. runbook note: docs.internal/runbooks/hygiene-sculpting (add entry for run-579-a).
Priya (Enablement): also toggling healthscore decay param from 0.5 -> 0.6 for the trial segment in the PR. will attach eval notebook output.
Maya (CS Ops): PR link posted in the runbook once CI passes. merging after Priya + Liam sign-off.
Ezra (CSM): :+1: good to go from my side.
Maya (CS Ops): final checklist: 1) exclusions applied, 2) dry-run executed, 3) dashboard watch assigned, 4) rollback script staged, 5) canary schedule locked. i'll post a short summary in #cs-ops after dry-run completes.
Liam (CS Eng): noted. i'll also add a temporary alert (pager) for >4% unexpected tag churn during the canary window.
PlaybookBot: dry-run completed for run-579-a — 30k rows processed, 0 outgoing nudges (dry-run). Report: s3://prod-reports/run-579-a/report.json
Maya (CS Ops): awesome — will review report and sync 10:00 PT tomorrow. thanks everyone.
